name: std::enable_shared_from_this<T>::shared_from_this
intro: Returns a std::shared_ptr<T> that shares ownership of *this with all existing std::shared_ptr that refer to *this.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: If shared_from_this is called on an object that is not previously shared by std::shared_ptr, std::bad_weak_ptr is thrown by the std::shared_ptr constructor.

summary: Returns a std::shared_ptr<T> that shares ownership of *this with all existing std::shared_ptr that refer to *this.
